amendment_note: Amendment 4 (Method sections and overlay dispatch, #2118, 2026-11-04): each of the four cast cards gains 'dispatch: <role>-tuning' in its frontmatter and a '## Method' section carrying a complete default for every method-class dimension, modelled on the librarian card — a numbered 'Default procedure' (the card's existing job text moved into it; the Briefing, Rules/Hard rules and Return paragraphs stay in place above it), the card's existing 'Model routing, suggested:' content as 'Model routing, default:' (the separate '## Model routing' section is folded in and removed), an 'Iteration budget, default:' derived from the card's steps cap and role, and an 'Example brief' in a text fence — so an entitled overlay always merges as a delta on a working default instead of throwing a missing-anchor error. The permission frontmatter, mode, temperature, steps, and the Return contract (receipt) section are byte-unchanged; no rule was weakened. Amendment 3 (receipt return contract, #2093, 2026-11-02): each of the four cast cards gains the identical '## Return contract (receipt)' section the critic and librarian cards also carry — the full work product goes to a file the caller names (or a reported scratch path; read-only roles hand it over as one fenced block after the receipt for the caller to file), and the final message is a receipt of at most ~1,500 tokens (verdict/status, key numbers, artifact paths, open items). The implementer's step-7 structured yaml is named as its receipt; the hypothesizer's return line routes the full spec-card draft to the work product. Amendment 2 (post-campaign linkage audit, 2026-09-14): the four cast cards learn the landed skill-integrity hooks — analyzer gains duty #6 (the skill-friction check: instructions-vs-reality mismatches → findings-ledger notes quoting both sources; repeated un-skilled idioms → proposal-type findings, provenance-tagged), implementer's structured-return enumeration gains skill_findings (the front-line rule: findings, never silent workarounds), hypothesizer's briefing gains the campaign findings ledger (amicode/skills-integrity/findings/, personal vault) as a prior, experimenter's checkout-registry path moves to the Research-Project location <project>/ledger/campaigns/CHECKOUTS.md. Amendment 1 (S3 model routing, #860): the model_routing slots of the four seeded role cards were filled with CLASS-level prefer-lists (a '## Model routing' section appending one 'Model routing, suggested:' line naming workhorse / strongest-reasoner / fast-cheap — the public suggestion vocabulary, never tuned assignments). seeded_sha256 entries updated to the amended bytes per this record's amendment protocol.
